findings.scope: Ten normal-scale FR/EN workshop images, widths1440/1024/768/390/320
findings.observed: The return-to-projects and help links visually concatenate. Both remain available; no claim of lost data or an inaccessible action.
findings.agreedCorrection: Wrap the two existing links only in flex flex-wrap gap-3.
findings.statusAtReview: Correction applied after these captures; a separate rebuilt targeted run must confirm the result.

limitations: Images do not prove keyboard order, focus trapping, ownership or save persistence; those assertions are in the specs and execution receipt.
Text200 is a documented doubled root-font experiment with actual control font16→32px; it is not native browser zoom or a complete WCAG audit.
No crop was required: all original heights are below6000px. Four text200 images deliberately show a useful viewport after real scrolling, not the entire enlarged page.
The header correction is supported by earlier before/after DOM bounds and this run’s global overflow assertions; the scrolled text200 screenshots do not themselves show the header.
No production traffic, external Stripe, unpublished media, all historical content or historical access incident is validated by this visual review.
